title: The test suite stops reporting failures that are not real
goal: Eleven tests that read the words off a screenshot report failures whenever the Mac is busy doing something else. The code is fine; the reading simply comes back empty under load, so every row keeps the number it was given and eleven checks go red. Anyone reading a red test run has to work out for themselves whether the app broke or the machine was busy, and that is not a question a test run should leave open.
notes:
REPRODUCED on 2026-09-20 while landing a-document-can-have-time, and it cost that runner most of an hour.

What happens: Tests/PhotonzRenderTests/SeparatedRowsSayTheirWordsTests.swift reads the words off Fixtures/settings-pane-2x.png with TextReader (Vision) and checks that the layers list names its rows after them. Under load Vision hands back nothing, every displayName falls through to the auto name, and the eleven tests report 21 issues that all look like this:

  Expectation failed: (names -> ["Text 9", ..., "Background"]).contains(words -> "General")

The evidence, all on the same machine and the same tree:

  Scripts/test.sh                       (walks/builds running)  -> 21 issues
  Scripts/test.sh --filter SeparatedRowsSayTheirWords (busy)    -> 21 issues
  Scripts/test.sh --filter SeparatedRowsSayTheirWords (idle)    -> passed, 7.45s
  Scripts/test.sh --filter SeparatedRowsSayTheirWords (idle)    -> passed, 7.42s
  Scripts/test.sh                       (idle)                  -> passed, 8530 tests, 190.9s

A throwaway diagnostic in the same tree showed the whole path working when nothing else was running: 19 pieces, 9 runs, TextReader returning General / Launch at login / Show in menu bar, and the layers list naming all nine rows correctly. So the reading is right and the timing is not.

WHY IT IS WORTH FIXING rather than living with: a runner that sees this cannot tell a break from a flake. This one stashed its own work twice and spent a full extra test cycle bisecting a regression that did not exist, and it very nearly filed the wrong bug against itself. That is the same failure mode the unmanned-loop epic was promoted for.

Where to look: TextReader.words(in:) in Sources/PhotonzRender/TextReader.swift and whatever timeout or request reuse is behind it.
acceptance: Running the whole suite while the machine is also building something reports the same result as running it on an idle machine, checked both ways
If the reading cannot be done reliably, the eleven tests say so out loud rather than failing: a skip with a reason beats a red that means nothing
The fix is proved by running the suite under deliberate load and getting the same answer twice

log.note: READ a-test-run-says-what-is-wrong-with-the-code-not BEFORE diagnosing. Both tasks watched SeparatedRowsSayTheirWordsTests go red with every text read coming back empty, and they have DIFFERENT causes: that one is a stale .build with mismatched field offsets (signal 11 in a copy of Layer, cured by rm -rf .build), this one is Vision returning nothing under machine load (cured by an idle machine, same tree). Same symptom, two causes, so whoever fixes either must be able to tell them apart or the other one will be declared fixed by accident.
